'''0.20d''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that fixed a bug that affected the availability of missions and items for all factions except the [[Scavengers]].

==Changelog==
* Fixed a bug with the availability of jobs and items for [[Black Market]], [[Renaissance Army]] and [[Fringe Settlers]]
